description: This file is a shell script used for testing git repository states and cloning behaviors. It sets up git repositories with specific commit and object states, and verifies cloning operations under different scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a description of the scenario.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Creates files with specified lines for testing.

methods.name: git update-index
methods.description: Adds files to the index for staging.

methods.name: git commit-tree
methods.description: Creates a commit object from tree and parent references.

methods.name: git write-tree
methods.description: Writes the current index as a tree object.

methods.name: git update-ref
methods.description: Updates a reference to a specific commit.

methods.name: git read-tree
methods.description: Loads a tree into the index.

methods.name: git hash-object
methods.description: Creates a hash object for a file or data.

methods.name: git cat-file
methods.description: Provides content or type information about objects.

methods.name: git fetch
methods.description: Downloads objects and refs from another repository.
